title: MCP server manifest
description: A Model-Context-Protocol server listed in the ziee hub. Transport is stdio | http | streamable-http (per the current MCP spec).

id.description: Globally unique stable id. Lowercase. Must match the filename (id.yaml).

environment_variables.description: Env vars passed to the subprocess (stdio transport) or referenced via ${VAR} interpolation in headers (http transports). For inputs the user must configure, see `required_env`.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent on each request (http/sse/streamable-http transports only). Values may reference env vars via ${VAR} interpolation; for inputs the user must configure, prefer `required_headers` over env-var indirection.

required_env.description: Declarative list of env vars the USER must configure post-install. Surfaced in the consumer UI as a 'Requires setup' affordance + structured config list. Use for stdio transports (where the subprocess reads the env vars directly). For http transports, declaring a secret here only makes sense when a header references it via ${VAR} interpolation; otherwise prefer `required_headers`.

required_headers.description: Declarative list of HTTP headers the USER must configure post-install. Surfaced in the consumer UI as a 'Requires setup' affordance + structured config list. Use for http/sse/streamable-http transports where a header takes direct user input (e.g. `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `X-Tenant-ID: <id>`). Cleaner than env-var indirection because there's no subprocess to inherit env on these transports — the header IS the surface.

required_input.description: A single user-configurable input the MCP server needs to function. Same shape for env vars and headers — the target surface is implied by which list (`required_env` vs `required_headers`) the entry appears in.

name.description: Key name. For `required_env` this is the env var name (e.g. `GITHUB_TOKEN`); for `required_headers` it's the HTTP header name (e.g. `Authorization`, `X-Tenant-ID`).

description.description: 1-2 sentence human description. Rendered under the name in the consumer's hub details drawer.

placeholder.description: Recommended example value. The consumer install path writes this verbatim into the new MCP server row so the user sees a realistic-looking-but-invalid value to replace. For Authorization-style headers include the full prefix (`Bearer ghp_xxxxxxxx…`) so the user pastes the right shape.

is_secret.description: True when the value carries credential material. Recommended default: true for env vars (most carry secrets); false for non-auth headers like tenant/config IDs. Set explicitly per input.

docs_url.description: Optional link to upstream docs explaining how to obtain the value. Consumer renders as a 'Get one →' link.
